name: Student’s t-Primitive Representation
definition: A volumetric representation for sparse-view CT that replaces standard Gaussian primitives with heavy-tailed Student’s t-distribution primitives to improve robustness against outliers and sparse-view ambiguity.
summary: Student’s t-Primitive Representation replaces Gaussian kernels with heavy-tailed primitives to improve robustness against outliers and sparse-view ambiguity in volumetric reconstruction.
